    Summarise the impact of ORDs on a density decay map

    summarise_ORD_impact.Rd

    Calculates the percentage of a density decay (DD) map contained within ORD footprints and buffer zones, together with the percentage affected by ORD barrier ("shadow") effects.

    Usage

    summarise_ORD_impact(
  DD_map,
  ORDpolys_with_buffer,
  DBS_map,
  DBS_withORDs,
  smalltol = 0.01
)

    Arguments

    DD_map

    A normalised density decay RasterLayer.

    ORDpolys_with_buffer

    An sf polygon object containing ORD footprints and associated buffer zones.

    DBS_map

    A RasterLayer containing Distance By Sea values calculated without ORDs.

    DBS_withORDs

    A RasterLayer containing Distance By Sea values calculated with ORDs present.

    smalltol

    Numeric threshold used to identify meaningful increases in Distance By Sea. Defaults to 0.01.

    Value

    A data frame with two columns:

    pc_in_ORD_plus_buffer

    Percentage of the DD map contained within ORD footprints and their buffer zones.

    pc_in_ORD_shadow

    Percentage of the DD map located within areas where Distance By Sea increases by more than smalltol due to the presence of ORDs.

    Details

    If the density decay map is normalised to sum to one, both outputs can be interpreted directly as percentages of the total density distribution.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) {
summarise_ORD_impact(
  DD_map = DD_map,
  ORDpolys_with_buffer = ORDpolys_with_buffer,
  DBS_map = DBS_map,
  DBS_withORDs = DBS_withORDs
)
}
